title: Read or Ignore? A Unified Benchmark for Typographic-Attack Robustness and Text Recognition in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models' over-reliance on misleading injected text (typographic attacks) using the Read-or-Ignore Benchmark (RIO-Bench), which compares performance on object-centric questions in clean versus attacked same-scene counterfactuals.

Assessing whether defense mechanisms against typographic attacks disproportionately suppress a model's genuine text-reading capabilities by evaluating their performance on text-centric Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks within the same scenes.
